title: DungeonMaster game module
description: An entire game as one document: rules, content, world, narrative, and starting conditions.

items.description: Drawn as well as loot, and only when the finder qualifies.

home.description: Enough to place them: the engine gathers everyone whose home is here when the party arrives.

items.description: Anyone this place names, plus anyone who names it as home.

bossTable.description: Drawn in the boss room. Without one the deepest room generates like any other.

grammar.and.description: Joins the last two items of a list.

grammar.or.description: Joins alternatives, as in a gate's unmet requirements.

grammar.list.separator.description: Between all but the last two items of a list.

grammar.list.many.description: A list of three or more; `head` is already joined.

grammar.count.description: A counted noun, as in "three hounds".

grammar.plural.description: How a counted noun is made plural when the content declares no plural of its own.

grammar.smallNumbers.description: Number words from zero upward, space separated. Counts past the end of this ladder are written as digits.

direction.here.description: Bearing to the tile you are standing on.

direction.nearby.description: Bearing too close or too diagonal to name.

roll.line.description: A roll shown as its arithmetic, so a player can learn the system.

roll.versus.description: The number a roll was measured against.

roll.swing.description: Advantage or disadvantage on a roll.

combat.outcome.critical.description: How a critical reads in an attack line.

combat.outcome.success.description: How a success reads in an attack line.

combat.outcome.failure.description: How a failure reads in an attack line.

combat.outcome.fumble.description: How a fumble reads in an attack line.

combat.attack.unnamed.description: Stands in when an attack names no ability.

combat.check.unnamed.description: Stands in when a check names neither skill nor attribute.

combat.damaged.resisted.description: Appended when resistance or vulnerability changed the number.

combat.started.description: A fight starts, listing who is in it.

move.blocked.description: Something stopped a step: a wall, or somebody standing there.

move.blocked.edge.description: What stopped a step when it was the end of the map rather than any terrain.

item.dropped.description: A body's spoils, named so they get picked up.

currency.gained.description: Coin arriving any way other than a sale.

currency.lost.description: Coin leaving any way other than a purchase.

discovered.trap.description: A trap is noticed before it fires.

gate.opened.bypass.description: Appended when a gate was forced rather than opened.

gate.opened.ability.description: Appended when an ability opened a gate.

gate.blocked.missing.description: Appended to a blocked gate, listing what would open it.

requirement.item.description: An item a requirement asks for.

requirement.skill.description: A skill rank a requirement asks for.

requirement.quest.description: A quest state a requirement asks for.

requirement.level.description: A level a requirement asks for.

requirement.ability.description: An ability a requirement asks for.

lore.learned.description: The party works something out. Nobody asked them to, so it is a note, not a quest.

lore.learned.sourced.description: The same, when the entry records where it came from.

quest.started.description: A job taken, with what it asks of you.

quest.started.plain.description: A job taken that has no description.

quest.stage.description: A quest moves on, when the stage wrote no journal prose.

quest.stage.journal.description: A quest moves on, with the stage's own journal line.

quest.failed.abandoned.description: Why a quest was lost: the party walked away from it.

quest.failed.conditions.description: Why a quest was lost: its `failWhen` became true.

quest.failed.timedOut.description: Why a quest was lost: its deadline ran out.

quest.failed.expired.description: Why a quest was lost: its time ran out while you were elsewhere.

party.stance.description: The party changes how carefully it moves.

party.following.default: The others fall in behind you.

sense.nearness.faint.description: How a weak or stale impression is introduced.

sense.nearness.close.description: How a strong impression is introduced.

sense.nearness.far.description: How a middling impression is introduced.

sense.unnamed.description: Stands in when a sense declares no name.

perception.investigating.default: {who} casts about, and starts toward something.
perception.investigating.description: A creature goes to look at what it noticed.

sense.empty.description: Using a sense that turns nothing up, when the sense has no name.

sense.empty.named.default: You stop. Nothing reaches you by {sense}.
sense.empty.named.description: Using a sense that turns nothing up. Always says something.

sense.impression.description: Noticing something, when the sense wrote no phrasing of its own.

look.creature.plain.default: {name}, and nothing more to be told from here.
look.creature.plain.description: Looking at a creature whose statblock wrote no description.

look.item.plain.description: Looking at an item that wrote no description.

look.place.plain.description: Looking at a place that wrote no description.

look.unseen.description: Looking at something that is not here.

refused.actor.missing.description: The action named somebody who is not in the game.

refused.action.unknown.default: "{action}" is not something you can do
refused.action.unknown.description: An action this version does not recognise.

refused.select.notParty.description: Selecting somebody who is not yours to command.

refused.move.noMap.description: Moving while not on a tactical map.

refused.move.tooFar.default: that is not one step away
refused.move.tooFar.description: Moving further than one tile at a time.

refused.travel.noRoad.default: there is no road that way
refused.travel.noRoad.description: No connection between these two areas.

refused.travel.noWayUp.default: there is no way back up
refused.travel.noWayUp.description: No route out of a dungeon by that door.

refused.travel.notYet.description: The way on is gated, and this is what is missing.

refused.travel.notYet.plain.description: The way on is gated, with nothing to say about why.

refused.travel.unknownArea.description: The module names no such area.

refused.leave.noExitFound.description: Leaving a dungeon before the exit is known.

refused.leave.nowhere.default: there is nowhere to go back to

refused.enter.noSuchPlace.description: Entering something that is not here.

refused.enter.unknownPlace.description: The place exists in no collection.

refused.enter.unknownDungeon.description: The module names no such dungeon.

refused.attack.noWeapon.description: Attacking with no ability and no weapon.

refused.ability.unknown.description: The module names no such ability.

refused.ability.notKnown.description: Using an ability this creature has not got.

refused.ability.prevented.default: {who} cannot take that action right now
refused.ability.prevented.description: A condition forbids the action type.

refused.ability.requirements.default: {who} does not meet the requirements for {ability}
refused.ability.requirements.description: An ability is gated and the gate is shut.

refused.ability.unavailable.description: An ability's own condition says no.

refused.ability.cooldown.description: An ability is still cooling down.

refused.cost.shortfall.description: An ability costs more than is left.

refused.target.none.description: An ability that needs a target found none.

refused.target.elsewhere.description: The target is on another map.

refused.target.noSight.description: Something solid is in the way.

refused.cast.silenced.description: A verbal component with speech prevented.

refused.cast.bound.description: A somatic component with gesture prevented.

refused.cast.noComponent.description: A material component the caster is not carrying.

refused.cast.notRitual.default: {spell} cannot be cast as a ritual
refused.cast.notRitual.description: Casting as a ritual something that is not one.

refused.cast.noSlot.description: Out of spell slots at that level.

refused.item.unknown.description: The module names no such item.

refused.item.notCarried.description: Acting on an item nobody holds.

refused.take.nothingHere.default: there is nothing here to take
refused.take.nothingHere.description: Nothing within reach to pick up.

refused.take.noSuchItem.description: That particular thing is not here.

refused.equip.notAllowed.description: Equipping something this character may not use.

refused.use.nothingHappens.description: Using an item that declares no effect.

refused.use.spent.description: Using an item whose charges are gone.

refused.give.tooFar.description: Handing something over from too far away.

refused.search.nothing.description: A search that turned nothing up.

refused.disarm.nothingHere.default: there is nothing here to disarm
refused.disarm.nothingHere.description: Disarming with no trap in reach.

refused.open.noSuchThing.description: Opening something that is not here.

refused.open.unknownGate.description: The module names no such gate.

refused.sense.unknown.description: Using a sense the module does not declare.

refused.stance.unknown.default: there is no way of moving called "{stance}"
refused.stance.unknown.description: Setting a stance the module does not declare.

refused.follow.inCombat.default: in a fight everyone acts on their own initiative

refused.rest.notHere.description: This place does not allow that kind of rest.

refused.rest.interrupted.default: something came looking before you could settle

refused.talk.unknownDialogue.description: The module names no such dialogue.

refused.reply.unknown.description: Choosing a reply that is not on offer.

refused.reply.locked.description: A reply that is shown but not available, and wrote no hint of its own.

refused.sell.unwanted.default: they have no use for that
refused.sell.unwanted.description: This shop will not take that.

refused.trade.barred.default: they will not deal with you — {missing}
refused.trade.barred.description: The shop is gated, and this is why.

refused.trade.barred.plain.default: they will not deal with you
refused.trade.barred.plain.description: The shop is gated, with nothing to say about why.

affordance.barred.description: A way that is shut, and what would open it.

affordance.needs.description: A shop that will not deal, and what would change that.

refused.quest.unknown.description: The module names no such quest.

refused.quest.unavailable.description: A quest whose requirements are unmet.

refused.quest.notTaken.default: you are not on that job

refused.internal.unknownResource.description: Content named a resource the ruleset does not declare.

refused.internal.unknownCondition.description: Content named a condition the ruleset does not declare.

refused.internal.unknownFaction.description: Content named a faction the module does not declare.

refused.internal.unknownOp.description: An effect this build does not know.

giver.description: A label. What actually puts the job in front of a player is that NPC’s offersQuests.

startingArea.description: Used only if no starting point of interest or dungeon is set.
